metadata_used.title: Narrated Video With Zero API Keys — OpenMontage Setup in Two Installs
metadata_used.description:
OpenMontage produces narrated video with no API keys, no account, and nothing sent to a cloud. This 45-second walkthrough shows the whole setup: two pip installs (piper-tts and faster-whisper), one voice-model download, and the tool registry picking both up on its own.

The narration you hear was generated by the commands on screen.

Commands shown:
  pip install piper-tts faster-whisper
  python -m piper.download_voices --download-dir ~/.piper/models en_US-lessac-medium
  make -s preflight | tail -n +2 | jq -c '.tts | {configured, total}'
  echo "Two installs, no keys." | piper -m en_US-lessac-medium --data-dir ~/.piper/models -f vo.wav

metadata.not_published: Exported only. Nothing was uploaded anywhere — no platform credentials are configured, and publishing is the user's call.

thumbnail_concepts.concept: The 27s payoff frame: terminal with {"configured":1,"total":10} and the green 'piper_tts -> available' pill, overlaid with 'NO API KEYS' in 3 words of heavy type.
thumbnail_concepts.why: Shows the result state on the recognizable tool surface, which is what the publish-director asks for.

thumbnail_concepts.concept: The closing frame with the full command session visible and 'Two installs.' set large in the empty lower half.
thumbnail_concepts.why: Legible at small sizes; the whole workflow is visible as texture behind two words.

platform_notes.youtube: Primary. 16:9 1080p, chapters map to the five script beats.
platform_notes.linkedin: Works as-is at 16:9; the terminal is dense but readable in-feed at full width.
platform_notes.shorts_reels_tiktok: Not viable without a re-cut — the 110-char verification command cannot survive a vertical crop above legible type size.
